result.instructions: Tools for Hubflo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which contacts did we add this week?"; "List the open tasks that are overdue on our onboarding projects."; "Show the latest form submissions for the intake form.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Hubflo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run hubflo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run hubflo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run hubflo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. hubflo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: hubflo_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List CRM contacts, filterable by e-mail, phone, company, project or owner. API: GET /api/v2/contacts.

phone.description: Only contacts with this phone number.

company_id.description: Only contacts of this company id.

project_id.description: Only contacts of this project id.

owner_id.description: Only contacts owned by this user id.

tools.name: hubflo_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact with its tags (first 100). API: GET /api/v2/contacts/{id}.

contact_id.description: The contact id (a UUID from the matching list tool).

tools.name: hubflo_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a CRM contact. Writes customer data. API: POST /api/v2/contacts.

tags.description: Tags. On update, these REPLACE the existing tags.

tools.name: hubflo_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Change fields of one contact; only the fields you send change. Tags, when sent, replace the existing tags. API: PATCH /api/v2/contacts/{id}.

contact_id.description: The contact id (a UUID from the matching list tool).

tags.description: Tags. On update, these REPLACE the existing tags.
